import numpy as np
from astropy.convolution import convolve, convolve_fft, Gaussian2DKernel

gaussian = Gaussian2DKernel(1, x_size=5, y_size=5)

# Case 1: input has NO NaNs, boundary='fill' with fill_value=NaN
ar1 = np.ones((10, 10))
r1 = convolve(ar1, gaussian, boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True)
rf1 = convolve_fft(ar1, gaussian, boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True)
probe('nan_count_nanfree_fill_nan', int(np.isnan(r1).sum()))
probe('all_finite_nanfree_fill_nan', int(np.all(np.isfinite(r1))))
probe('border_val_0_0_nanfree', float(r1[0, 0]))
probe('border_val_9_9_nanfree', float(r1[9, 9]))
d1 = np.abs(r1 - rf1)
probe('nan_count_diff_vs_fft_nanfree', int(np.isnan(d1).sum()))

# Case 2: input contains a single NaN (the case that 'worked')
ar2 = np.ones((10, 10))
ar2[5, 5] = np.nan
r2 = convolve(ar2, gaussian, boundary='fill', fill_value=np.nan, preserve_nan=True)
probe('nan_count_input_nan', int(np.isnan(r2).sum()))
probe('nan_at_center_input_nan', int(bool(np.isnan(r2[5, 5]))))
